purpose: Turn a story, question, or contradiction into a voluntary and testable improvement in inquiry, without assigning permanent mind types or virtue scores.

distinction.dialogue: A record of utterances shaped by setting, role, prompts, topic familiarity and language.
distinction.observed_practice: Task-scoped behavior that can be described and rechecked.
distinction.learned_capability: Transfer or improvement demonstrated under a specified test.

laneset.recursive_limit: At most two unverified nested review loops per exercise before returning to a named observable or explicit UNKNOWN.

learning_cycle.action: Choose your own useful question and success criterion.
Distinguish observed evidence, inference, hypothesis, metaphor and unknown.
Describe a credible rival or inverse, including a condition under which the original is wrong.
Record a dated prediction and disconfirming outcome before the test.
Run a reversible bounded exercise or mark it untested.
Retain errors, harms, unexpected positives, affected-party objections and missing data.
Attempt a related problem with changed context and record any loss of performance.
Keep, revise, stop or retire the idea with a link to its prior version.

first_lesson.title: Can the wave-surfer survive without the next wave?
first_lesson.inverse: What if the form remains viable after sustaining input is removed?
first_lesson.engineering_translation: A browser worker receives a stream; removing the stream should produce an honest visible state.
first_lesson.tested_claim: A bounded simulation can report a missing input and recover state without claiming to be a conscious entity.
first_lesson.test_fixture: Synthetic worker state only; no monitoring of humans, devices, accounts or services.
first_lesson.disconfirming_result: UI displays healthy status after input has stopped or invents a continuation.
first_lesson.optional_second_question: What remains as evidence when the worker has ended?
first_lesson.no_answer_required: The ocean's consciousness or metaphysical continuity

formative_measurement.unit: A dated attempt at one task, not a permanent learner profile
formative_measurement.comparison_baseline: Ordinary notebook and peer challenge, matched to the same tasks

experiment_rivals.H0: A simple notebook/peer-review workflow is as useful or better for the same learners and tasks.
experiment_rivals.H1: Typed CoLaneSets improve source tracking, correction or transfer enough to justify their overhead.

learner_rights.choice: Learner may choose objective, skip items and stop without penalty.
learner_rights.child_scope: Age-appropriate experience; guardian consent plus child assent for underage participants; no unsupervised profiling.
learner_rights.corrections: A learner can dispute a characterization and retain a dated correction.
learner_rights.sensitive_data: Do not infer protected attributes, mental-health conditions, intelligence, consciousness or inherent worth from text.

value_direction.desired: More useful, accurate, revisable and ethically accountable inquiries
value_direction.bad_outcome_rule: Keep harm and failure as harm and failure; never automatically relabel them good
value_direction.affected_parties: Independent objections count even if they contradict the narrator

terms.CoScendence: Existing exploratory family for improvement or becoming; no validated aggregate psychometric meaning.
terms.CoSendence: Exact user spelling on 2026-11-15 is preserved as unresolved term candidate, not silently equated with CoScendence.

currentness.prototype: Public GitHub source exists; separate web-serving/readers may need fresh checks
